findings: The functional catalog exists, but its public state, styling, accessibility, package, and verification rules are inconsistent across control families.
Complex controls duplicate focus, dismissal, collection, and positioning responsibilities that mature headless libraries already maintain.
The default skin has implicit and consumer-wide CSS effects and does not provide complete recipes for the overlay and navigation family.
The repository does not yet expose a release package or one canonical product gate set.

findings.summary: Base UI was both conditional and unconditionally selected.
OverlayRoot and FoundryProvider both claimed the root boundary.
Toast was both singular/manual and provider-queued.
Native dialog wording conflicted with semantic HTMLElement content.
Tabs always-together wording conflicted with manual activation.
Future Link was implied to be a current native Core v1 control.

reviews.conclusion: Owner direction is otherwise preserved, but six contradictions required one bounded correction.
reviews.invalidated_by: The bounded correction after this review.

reviews.subject: Core v1 control contract
reviews.scope: Whether a Maestro packet can implement every public boundary and recovery path without inventing behavior.

filtered_passages: Prior findings, workshop state, handoff, PR discussion, and unrelated history excluded.
original_decision_evidence: The canonical contract and current exact exports were supplied.

journeys.name: export migration
journeys.trace: Current wildcard and named runtime/type exports enter the matrix; every name needs retain, rename, remove, or internal disposition; declarations and packed imports validate completion; an omitted name blocks the packet.

journeys.name: provider and portal
journeys.trace: Skin, locale, labels, direction, target, and Toast config enter the nearest provider; nested boundaries own independent queues and portals; missing/replaced targets and unmount require deterministic recovery without fabricated callbacks.

journeys.name: native controls and surfaces
journeys.trace: Props enter Field, Group, Button, native inputs, Banner, and surfaces; controlled, uncontrolled, reset, loading, disabled, label, action, and announcement paths reach exact elements/refs; conflicts refuse explicitly.

journeys.name: Toast lifecycle
journeys.trace: Show, dedupe, queue, promote, update, action, pause, timeout, dismiss, stale ID, F6, and provider-unmount paths reach one polite viewport; queue and focus recovery determine completion.

journeys.name: modal lifecycle
journeys.trace: Trigger, parent, Escape, close, outside pointer, nested layer, missing target, and controlled decline paths reach Dialog/Drawer state and focus; restoration occurs only after accepted close.

journeys.name: Popover and Menu
journeys.trace: Trigger, placement, anchor loss, arrows, typeahead, disabled/all-disabled, selection prevention, outside pointer, Tab, Escape, and controlled decline reach non-modal state and reason-specific focus recovery.

journeys.name: Tabs
journeys.trace: Initial value, arrows, activation mode, pointer, disabled/missing selection, removal, no-enabled state, panel focus fallback, nesting, and parent decline reach deterministic selection/focus outcomes.

journeys.name: SSR and hydration
journeys.trace: Server rendering, initially open content, hydration, delayed portal target, nested providers, target replacement, and config mismatch reach stable IDs and deterministic post-mount behavior without state callbacks.

not_assessed: Implementation feasibility beyond source/API inspection and live runtime proof.
missing_evidence: Executable Base UI proof remains required before production retention.

findings.summary: Runtime/type exports and new supporting shapes were not exact.
Provider, portal, nested queue, and F6 ownership were incomplete.
Compound part topology and forwarding were incomplete.
Field, Group, loading announcement, Banner, and action contracts were incomplete.
Toast live, queue, timing, race, stale-ID, and focus recovery were incomplete.
Modal resolver, nesting, decline, and restoration paths were incomplete.
Popover/Menu placement, anchor, event, typeahead, and decline paths were incomplete.
Tabs defaults and invalid, disabled, removal, no-enabled, and missing-panel recovery were incomplete.
Initially open SSR, target recovery, nested identity, and mismatch behavior were incomplete.
Stale architecture statements contradicted the detailed matrix.

reviews.conclusion: All required journeys were traced, and ten blocking specification gaps required the one permitted correction.
reviews.invalidated_by: The bounded correction after this review.
